CompactList.show / PopupGeometry.dropdown gained maxHeightFraction.

rcaNotes: No new wiring: ReaderActivity keeps calling ReaderPanels.showReadingSettings(this, chrome.gear) on main (U §2.6: delete the pinned openReadingSettings branch there). The popup itself hides the chrome via host.setChromeVisible(false).
For live samples in the 상태 표시 chooser, the ReaderActivity host should implement StatusSampleHost.statusSample(item) (main thread, no IO); without it the chooser shows StatusItem.example.
넘기는 방식 saves Settings.saveApp(app.copy(readMode = m)); ReaderActivity.onAppSettingsSaved must switch the open book live (viewPart includes a.readMode).
deviations: compactRowBackground keeps the black full-width line as its default and draws the LINE_LIGHT 12dp-inset line only with light=true (compactRow uses it), so RulesDialog (another lane) is unchanged.
더보기 expanded state stays remembered for the process (pre-existing); the no-scroll guarantee applies to the collapsed main section.
